evidence.reason: The bound calculation uses only the interval plus AccuracySec and never accounts for RandomizedDelaySec. systemd can postpone a timer activation by up to the configured randomized delay, so a timer such as OnUnitInactiveSec=1min, AccuracySec=1s, RandomizedDelaySec=10min can next fire far beyond the computed 61s bound, causing the adapter to time out or fence incorrectly. The maximum randomized delay should be added to the bound (zero when omitted) or the timer rejected before fencing.
